rows.assessment: Appropriate existing source; future boundary incomplete
rows.responsibility: Persisted independently identified state or an explicit read projection. Reuse Projection/session ownership; do not turn every immutable draft/result into a separate Entity.
PreparationContext, lookup observations, assessments, revision plans, field contributions and handoff envelopes are immutable snapshots. An ID/reference field does not by itself require Entity.
Finite applicability, question target, next-action and readiness values fit. Payload variants are supported by the selected dialect; they are not an illegal custom meta-type.

ValidatePreparationContext can legally reject/return without effects in this dialect. Recording notes/answers/revisions/handoffs requires exact guarded commit/replay ownership. Guard-only Operations are not automatically mislabeled Queries.
Retrieve from a declared Entity/projection using exact source/key/predicate. Do not use Query as the computation of missing fields or as an undeclared direct filesystem/search effect.
Derive facts, differences, missing fields and bounded assessment values. SelectAction is a legal pure helper; avoid claiming a Calculation retrieves external state or records a decision.
Reusable Boolean invariants: Work/project shape, exact binding consistency, revision partitions, candidate completeness, and handoff equality. Inline Operation guards remain legal.

NextSemanticAction selects a semantic action and is a good Policy. Separate selection of a preparation strategy from calculation of readiness. A zero-effect enforced decision Policy is supported by the dialect.

rows.assessment: No new Workflow required by current design
rows.responsibility: The session loop may use commands, next-action Policy and existing lifecycles. Add a Define-owned Workflow only for explicitly selected durable multi-operation scheduling/recovery; shared Lab construction/admission/publication remain outside.
A logical bounded request/response contract for source lookup or handoff. It is not merely a field transform, implementation adapter, signing permission or a new universal Port meta-type.
Past fact after a committed state change. Requires explicit emitter/receiver, payload identity, selected Event profile and delivery/replay semantics. A handoff command is not itself an Event.
Project exact inputs into request/candidate/successor/handoff shapes. Do not hide owner choices, norm creation, validation or storage effects inside a Mapping.

QuestionLifecycle and SessionLifecycle represent valid transitions. NextAction is an advisory result enum/Policy, not itself a persisted state machine. New lifecycle transitions need explicit contracts if selected.

Entry is checked separately from the 13 DomainSpec backend meta-types. Every public operation/query must have a declared selected Entry path, access contract and custody rules; pure local CLI evaluation does not imply that authenticated Entry was exercised.

excluded: UI candidate/deferred types and superseded Saga are not required by this backend capability.
